subject.title: fix(sessions): preserve parent lifecycle for parallel children

question: Should `succeedsParent` become the public `sessions.create` lifecycle contract, with legacy omission preserved and every remote client allowed to fall back against older Gateways?
rationale: The patch adds a public Gateway/SDK parameter whose lifecycle semantics affect plugins and external clients; the mechanical Control UI fallback is clear, but the permanent contract needs an owner decision.

options.title: Adopt explicit disposition
options.body: Keep the optional boolean contract, preserve omission semantics, and require all remote clients to retry the exact pre-execution schema rejection.

options.title: Choose a different lifecycle API
options.body: Replace the boolean with a maintainer-selected representation before exposing a new Gateway and SDK contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt explicit disposition
recommendation.body: Keep the optional boolean contract, preserve omission semantics, and require all remote clients to retry the exact pre-execution schema rejection.

likelyOwner.reason: The related lifecycle-design discussion identifies this person as the likely owner of the pre-existing session lifecycle contract.
